name: AMD RDRAND/RDSEED Erratum
description: Some AMD processors are affected by erratum where RDRAND and RDSEED instructions may not properly return random values.
This issue is documented in AMD Security Bulletin SB-7055 and can affect the security of cryptographic operations that rely on these hardware random number generators.
more-information: The vulnerability can be detected by running concurrent threads that exercise the RDRAND and RDSEED instructions.
Systems that fail this test should update their firmware to the latest version provided by the manufacturer.
failure-impact: Processors with this erratum may generate predictable random values, which could compromise cryptographic operations and security features that depend on hardware random number generation.
resolution: Contact your OEM for a firmware update that addresses AMD Security Bulletin SB-7055.
